WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS behavior_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON ab.translink = tx.transreg
  JOIN trader AS tr ON tx.trdref = tr.tradereg
  GROUP BY tr.tradekind
),
shares AS (
  SELECT tradekind, behavior_count,
         1.0 * behavior_count / SUM(behavior_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM type_counts
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT s.tradekind, s.behavior_count, s.share,
       s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_average
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL
  AND s.share > a.avg_share
